summary: Route NLP adapters through central SubLLM policy

delivery.outcome: The nlp2koru and nlp2coru adapters delegate model and provider selection to their registered central SubLLM routes while retaining injected backends and bounded offline behavior.
nonGoals: Change SubLLM provider ordering or credentials
Remove the model compatibility parameters in this release
Update standalone package dependency metadata or README files
Change deterministic DSL validation or dispatch semantics

architecture.decision: Use korullm.run_subllm_messages as the only default remote completion boundary and keep each adapter's existing LLMBackend protocol for deterministic injection.
interfaceChanges: Existing model arguments remain accepted but no longer select a provider or model
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected ticket merge; no persisted state or remote policy is changed.

validation.evidence: focused pytest output and protected checks
